full_prompt_en: A square cinematic color image shows a lone dark figure on a muddy road leading toward a small house in thick coastal fog. The upper two-thirds is an almost uninterrupted blue-gray sky, with faint grain and slight tonal clouding but no clear sun. Near the low horizon, open flat ground stretches to the left and vanishes into haze, crossed by a sparse line of short fence posts. The road begins broad and dark in the lower center, with wet ruts and pale puddles catching dull reflections. It narrows toward the middle distance, where the solitary person stands as a small upright silhouette. To the right, a white two-story house with a pitched roof and porch appears partly swallowed by mist. Its windows and roofline remain visible but softened, while tall weeds obscure the lower walls. A sequence of utility poles follows the road; the nearest dark pole rises high at the right edge, and thin wires sweep diagonally across the pale sky toward smaller poles farther back. The linework of the cables and fence posts gives the nearly empty landscape a fragile human geometry. Desaturated blue, slate, and charcoal cover most of the frame, with only the off-white house providing a modest pale accent. Overcast light arrives broadly from the sky, flattening hard shadows but making wet patches on the ground shine softly. The distant forms lose contrast quickly, while the nearest road retains coarse soil and grass texture. The overall composition places a tiny traveler under a vast blank sky, using the wire lines and receding road to make the quiet fog feel isolated and uneasy.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感彩色图像呈现一名孤独的深色人影站在泥泞小路上，路通向浓重海边雾气中的小屋。上方三分之二几乎是连续的蓝灰天空，只有淡颗粒和轻微云调变化，没有清楚太阳。低地平线附近，开阔平地向左伸展并消失于雾中，其上横过稀疏的矮篱柱。小路从下方中央宽而深暗地开始，湿车辙和浅水洼映着黯淡反光。它向中远处收窄，孤身行者在那儿成为一枚小小直立剪影。右侧一栋白色双层尖顶带门廊的房屋局部被雾吞没。窗户和屋顶线仍可辨却柔化，杂草遮住下部墙体。一列电线杆沿路延伸；最近的深色杆在右缘高高升起，细线从它斜扫浅色天空，通向更远的小杆。电缆和篱柱的线性关系为近乎空无的地景带来脆弱的人造几何。低饱和蓝色、板岩色和炭黑覆盖大部分画面，只有灰白小屋提供有限浅色强调。阴天天光从上方宽阔到来，压平硬阴影，却让地面湿处轻轻发亮。远处形态迅速失去反差，近处道路仍保留粗土与草的纹理。整体构图把微小旅人放在浩大空白的天空下，以电线和退远道路让安静浓雾显得孤立而不安。
style_prompt_en: The image uses heavy atmospheric haze and a restricted blue-gray palette to turn ordinary forms into quiet silhouettes. A low horizon leaves a wide field of pale, grainy emptiness above darker textured ground. Thin linear elements recede toward a small focal accent, giving structure to the soft space. Wet or slightly reflective patches remain subdued; there are no sharp highlights or saturated color bursts. Overcast light lowers contrast with distance, while nearby surfaces retain a rougher tactile edge. The overall treatment is sparse, cinematic, and unsettling, with scale carried by the imbalance between tiny dark marks and vast light space.
style_prompt_zh: 图像用厚重空气雾感和受限的蓝灰配色，把日常形体转成安静剪影。低地平线让宽阔、带颗粒的浅色空处压在较深而有纹理的地面上方。细线性元素退向一个小焦点，为柔软空间提供结构。湿润或略带反光的色块仍克制，没有锋利高光或饱和色爆发。阴天光使距离越远反差越低，近处表面保有更粗粝的触觉边缘。整体处理稀疏、具电影感而令人不安，尺度来自微小深色痕迹与浩大浅色空间之间的不平衡。
theme_en: A lone figure approaches a small house through blue-gray coastal fog
theme_zh: 一名孤影穿过蓝灰色海边浓雾，走向一栋小屋
name: Gloomy atmosphere
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
